allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File "e:\\microsoft_eraya" | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch "node_modules|\\.venv|__pycache__|\\.next" } | Select-Object @{N="Path";E={$_.FullName.Replace\("e:\\microsoft_eraya\\",""\)}} | Sort-Object Path | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(cd "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\backend"; python -m venv .venv; Write-Host "venv created at $\(Resolve-Path .venv\)")

PowerShell(cd "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\backend"; .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; Write-Host "pip upgraded to: $\(.\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m pip --version\)")

PowerShell(cd "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\backend"; Start-Process -FilePath ".\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe" -ArgumentList "-m daphne -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000 eraya.asgi:application" -WorkingDirectory "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\backend" -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/agents/instances/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "Backend UP: HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "Backend starting... \($\($_.Exception.Message\)\)" })

PowerShell(cd "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\frontend"; Start-Process -FilePath "npm" -ArgumentList "run dev" -WorkingDirectory "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\frontend" -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; "Frontend UP: HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "Frontend starting... \($\($_.Exception.Message\)\)" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; "Frontend UP: HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "Still starting... \($\($_.Exception.Message\)\)" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; "Frontend UP: HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Host "Not on 3000, trying..." -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3001" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "Frontend UP on :3001 HTTP $\($r2.StatusCode\)" } catch { "Still compiling: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Set-Location "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\frontend"; npm run dev 2>&1 } -Name "eraya-frontend"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 25; Receive-Job $job -Keep | Select-Object -Last 15)

PowerShell(Start-Job -Name "torch-install" -ScriptBlock { cd "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\backend"; .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "e:\\microsoft_eraya\\backend\\torch_install.log" } | Out-Null; Write-Host "PyTorch CUDA install started in background \(job: torch-install\)")
